name: Nandini Layout Club – Badminton Coaching
description: Located in West Bangalore, Nandini Layout Club offers badminton coaching within a classic club setting, blending heritage ambiance with quality training for members of all ages.

contact.address: Nandini Layout Club, 8th Main Road, near ISKCON Temple, Nandini Layout, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560096

highlights: Indoor wooden-shuttle court in excellent condition
Small batch sizes for personalized attention
Regular intra-club tournaments and social mixers
Library, garden lounge & leisure facilities for members
Easy access near ISKCON temple and community venues

courses.title: Beginner Basics
courses.description: Introduction to grip, stance, and basic strokes.
courses.schedule: Mon, Wed, Fri – 5:00 PM to 6:00 PM

courses.title: Intermediate Skills
courses.description: Footwork, shot variety, and match-play drills.
courses.schedule: Tue, Thu, Sat – 5:30 PM to 7:00 PM

instructors.name: Coach Prasanna Kumar
instructors.bio: Coach Prasanna has nurtured young club members to district-level competitions.

facilities.name: Indoor Shuttle Court
facilities.description: Wooden court under natural airflow—ideal for controlled play.

facilities.name: Lounge & Gardens
facilities.description: Clubhouse lounge and garden terrace for members to relax.

facilities.name: Library & Recreation
facilities.description: Compact library and table-tennis/carrom options near the court.

achievements: Over 5 intra-club badminton tournaments held annually
High member satisfaction for personalized coaching
Celebrated 25+ years of sports & social community in 2015

policies.cancellation: Notify 12 hours in advance for session rescheduling
policies.makeup: One makeup session allowed per month
policies.payment: Monthly advance; refunds only for medical reasons

certifications: Affiliated to local district badminton association

awards.title: Best Community Sports Club – Nandini Layout
